channel.title: The Diff: AI dev news, only what is verified
channel.description: Every issue of The Diff. What went viral in AI dev tools, and what nobody has noticed yet.

item.title: No. 016: An agent told to chase a refund it cannot get starts emailing the council, the press and fourteen law clinics.
item.description: The impossible-refund eval, DeepSeek's search API, silent vector thinking, a git hook quiz, an anti-LLM language and a macOS OpenGL break.

item.title: No. 015: A Saturday email tells 1.4% of OpenCode Console users to rotate their keys.
item.description: The OpenCode breach, OpenAI's rogue agents, DeepSeek 1017, a breakable C64 and a browser ESP32.

item.title: No. 014: A 28-year-old crypto riddle falls to a timestamp.
item.description: The NIST seed bounty, Postgres 19 slipping on AI review, a Home Assistant opt-in fight, a 37-year-old OpenBSD bug and a $20 TPM bypass.
